facts.fact: Starlink launched in Zimbabwe in September 2024; Dandemutande is its authorised reseller; Potraz counted 30,907 active terminals in Q1 2025 and Starlink carried 35.05% of fixed internet traffic in Q4 2025 (168.21 petabytes), per the article.
Subscribers: 23,410 at 2024-Q4, per Potraz (VSAT subscriptions, up 513.79% in the quarter).

note: Dated Starlink launch and Potraz VSAT count; Potraz Q1 2025 terminal count in sale fact.
